hobb.name: The Hobb

evolution.name: Insatiable
evolution.how_it_works: Insatiable: eats buildings outright. Its button, Gorge, instantly devours a small enemy troop in front of it.

hobb.how_it_works: Three Stomachs: every enemy troop it kills is devoured. One full stomach heals it, two also add damage, and with all three full it grows bigger with more health and damage. Munchies: if it goes 8 seconds without devouring, it gets hungry and bites faster, with bonus damage against buildings and towers.

editor.name: The Editor

evolution.name: Rewrite
evolution.how_it_works: Rewrite: its button pushes back every enemy troop in its lane at once.

editor.how_it_works: Quiet Revision: every 5 seconds it pushes the enemy troop that has come furthest back by 1.5 tiles. It only works while no enemy troop is within 3 tiles of it.

john_arms.name: John Arms

evolution.name: No Hard Feelings
evolution.how_it_works: No Hard Feelings: its button starts a Flurry whenever you like, and the exhaustion only lasts 2 seconds.

john_arms.how_it_works: Respect: it never attacks first and only goes for whatever damages it. Flurry: once provoked it spins for 4 seconds, hitting everything around it and knocking enemies back, then it is exhausted for 3 seconds, slow and unable to attack.

kardemosh.name: Kardemosh

evolution.name: God of Flesh
evolution.how_it_works: God of Flesh: starts with some skin on. Its button, Flay, rips the skin off the nearest enemy troop for big damage and wears it.

kardemosh.how_it_works: Skin Stealer: every troop it kills gives it skin, a shield that slowly rots away. With little skin it hunts troops and moves faster. With plenty of skin it calms down and walks for buildings. Halt: a stun freezes it far longer than normal, but it adapts and a third stun does nothing.

gasket.name: The Gasket

evolution.name: Do Not Enter
evolution.how_it_works: Do Not Enter: its button, Close the Lid, hits the troop inside with a big burst of damage and opens the lid again straight away.

gasket.how_it_works: Comfortable End: while empty it lures the nearest enemy ground troop within 4 tiles inside, where the troop cannot act and slowly loses health. One troop at a time. Flying troops and troops that only attack buildings are never lured. Destroying it frees the troop, dazed.

creeler.name: The Creeler

evolution.name: Empty Basket
evolution.how_it_works: Empty Basket: its button, Drop, lets go of the carried troop early from height, hurting it and everything around it.

creeler.how_it_works: Snatch: it grabs an enemy ground troop that comes within reach and flies it all the way back to that troop's own back line, then returns to the towers. While carrying it cannot attack and takes extra damage. One troop at a time, every 10 seconds.

spiker.name: The Spiker
spiker.how_it_works: Spike Field: black spikes erupt in the area, then stay for 4 seconds, hurting and slowing anything inside. The damage grows the longer something stays. Towers take less damage.

dargalean.name: The Dargalean

evolution.name: Lost Hours
evolution.how_it_works: Lost Hours: its button, Cuddle, makes nearby enemies stop attacking for 2 seconds.

dargalean.how_it_works: Irresistible: every enemy troop within 3 tiles has to target it for as long as it lives. A cheap decoy to pull troops away.

spacefarer.name: The Spacefarer

evolution.name: From the Future
evolution.how_it_works: From the Future: its button, Time Skip, blinks it 3 tiles back toward your side and it keeps its attack speed.

spacefarer.how_it_works: Three Hours: it never tires. Every 3 seconds of non-stop attacking makes it attack 10% faster, up to 50%, until it stops for a moment.

individuals.name: The Individuals

evolution.name: Seen Through a Screen
evolution.how_it_works: Seen Through a Screen: their button, Flatten, makes them impossible to target for 2 seconds.

individuals.how_it_works: Gaze: the troop they are fighting is filled with dread and attacks 30% slower. Every 4 seconds they blink for a second and the dread pauses. Distract: hit one and they all turn toward the attacker.

chain.name: The Chain
chain.how_it_works: Link: up to 3 enemy troops in the area are chained for 6 seconds. Damage dealt to one is dealt in full to all of them.

devil.name: The Devil In The Forest

evolution.name: Deeper Into the Woods
evolution.how_it_works: Deeper Into the Woods: its button switches the drain to a new troop straight away and drains three times as fast for 3 seconds.

devil.how_it_works: Smile: enemy ranged troops walk right up to it instead of shooting from afar. Happy Face: it drains one enemy troop within 1.5 tiles at a time, 20 a second, and heals itself by the same amount. The troop it drains deals half damage to it. Towers, buildings and spells hit it at full damage, and a troop that is stunned or blinking has its eyes closed and is safe.

pardoned.name: The Pardoned One

evolution.name: A Thousand Years
evolution.how_it_works: A Thousand Years: her button, Feather Storm, fires every feather she has left at once, spread over every enemy in range. They all come back and heal her, but she is grounded for 4 seconds afterwards.

pardoned.how_it_works: Sharp Wings: every shot is a feather that comes back after 1.5 seconds and heals her for the damage it dealt. She has 12. With more than 8 out at once she is grounded, so melee ground troops can hit her, until enough come back. Pardoned: killed while flying, she is born anew once at your main tower with 40% health. Killed while grounded, she is gone for good.

cloud.name: The Cloud

evolution.name: Thunderhead
evolution.how_it_works: Thunderhead: its button, Storm, drifts it 3 tiles toward the enemy side and strikes straight away.

cloud.how_it_works: Hovering: it stays where it is placed but counts as flying, so only troops that hit air, towers and spells can hurt it. Lightning Strike: it strikes an enemy troop within 2.5 tiles below it for 60 damage and a 1 second stun, then waits 5 to 8 seconds. Lightning goes straight through shields such as Kardemosh's skin. Irritated: whatever hurts it gets the next strike, if it is close enough.

danger_zone.name: The Danger Zone
danger_zone.how_it_works: Enrage: for 10 seconds every living troop inside, yours and the enemy's, attacks and moves 35% faster and takes 25% less damage. Backlash: when the zone ends, every troop it enraged loses 10% of its max health. Towers, buildings and lifeless troops are not affected. Play it where you have more troops.

hanged_one.name: The Hanged One

evolution.name: The Rope
evolution.how_it_works: The Rope: its button, Leash, pulls the nearest troop of yours within 6 tiles right next to it, so it is never alone.

hanged_one.how_it_works: Cannot Strike the Living: it ignores every troop and walks straight to buildings and towers. Not Living: The Gasket cannot lure it, The Devil In The Forest and Mrs. Give & Take cannot drain it, and The Danger Zone cannot enrage it. Lost Dog: while a troop of yours is within 2 tiles, it takes 20% less damage.

clone.name: The Clone
clone.how_it_works: Clone: every troop of yours in the area gets a copy next to it with half its health and damage and the same abilities, in the base form. Buildings are not copied. Clones count as living, and a clone of The Pardoned One cannot be born anew.

give_and_take.name: Mrs. Give & Take

evolution.name: Return
evolution.how_it_works: Return: her button pours her whole life pool out at once, shared between every ally in range.

give_and_take.how_it_works: Take: she drains one enemy within 4 tiles at a time, 15 a second, into her life pool (up to 300). She goes first for whoever is attacking the ally she is healing, and with her pool over half full she drains 50% faster. Give: she heals the most hurt ally in range 20 a second from her pool, and once it is empty she pays with her own health, even if it kills her. Lifeless troops can be neither drained nor healed.

blinker.name: The Blinker

evolution.name: Quicker Than You Can Blink
evolution.how_it_works: Quicker Than You Can Blink: its button, Overzoom, forces one more Zoom past its limit for a bite that does three times the damage, and then it dies.

blinker.how_it_works: It only eats flesh: it attacks living troops and ignores buildings, towers and The Hanged One. Zoom: when its target is more than 2 tiles away, it dashes up to 4 tiles in an instant and bites on arrival. Each Zoom adds 1 strain, and strain wears off by 1 every 4 seconds without Zooming. It stops itself at 4 strain, because 5 kills it.

swarm.name: The Swarm

evolution.name: Formation
evolution.how_it_works: Formation: its button pulls every surviving member together into a tight group, and they charge 50% faster for 3 seconds.

swarm.how_it_works: Fifteen short humanoids with sharp swords. No special ability, just numbers: they shred tanks and anything that can only handle one troop at a time.
